description_en: Submits a snapshot job. You can specify the ID or URL of a media file, the snapshot time, and the format. The system generates snapshots based on these parameters and saves them to the specified location
description_zh: 本接口用于提交截图任务。通过该接口，用户可以指定媒体文件的ID或URL，以及截图的时间点和格式，系统将根据这些参数生成截图并保存到指定的位置
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-snapshot-job --input Type=Media Media=oss://bucket/object.mp4 --biz-output Type=OSS Media=oss://test-bucket/output-_Count_.jpg --template-config '{"OverwriteParams":{},"TemplateId":"000096e8864746a0b6f30000"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitSnapshotJob

fields.help_en:
The input media.

If Type is set to OSS, enter the OSS URL.

If Type is set to Media, enter the media asset ID.

The OSS URL must follow these rules:

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
In the URLs, bucket is the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.

The OSS bucket in the URL must be added to the IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html before it can be used
fields.help_zh:
输入媒体。

当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址。

Type为Media时填入媒资ID。

OSS地址规则为：

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径。

URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMShttps://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html后再使用

fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The output media.

If Type is set to OSS, enter the OSS URL.

If Type is set to Media, enter the media asset ID.

The OSS URL must follow these rules:

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

In the URLs, bucket is the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path.

When capturing multiple static snapshots, the object must contain the "{Count}" placeholder.

When capturing a sprite snapshot, the object must contain the "{TileCount}" placeholder.

For WebVTT snapshots, the object suffix must be ".vtt".

The OSS bucket in the URL must be added to the IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html before it can be used
fields.help_zh:
输出媒体。

当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址。

Type为Media时填入媒资ID。

OSS地址规则为：

oss://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径。

截取多张静态截图时，object必须要带有”{Count}“占位符；

截取雪碧图时，object必须要带有“{TileCount}”占位符。

WebVTT截图object的后缀必须是“.vtt”。

URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMShttps://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html后再使用
